headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Since the 17:17 edition the war’s most volatile sectors have sharpened. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest theatre, logging 56 ownership changes in the last 24 hours with both sides’ casualty rates accelerating above 900 per hour. Stlican Shelf has erupted, recording seven fresh flips in the past two hours and 43 daily transitions, pushing losses for each faction past 300 per hour. Godcrofts added four new events in the last two hours, its 31 daily flips accompanied by sharply rising casualties and enlistments. Stonecradle posted three recent captures and 17 daily changes, loss curves steepening for both sides. Callahan’s Passage saw two fresh captures in the last two hours, with casualties now climbing above 650 per hour each. Dead Lands likewise recorded two new events and accelerating losses near 300 per hour. Meanwhile Viper Pit’s casualty rates have cooled and Fisherman’s Row shows no new two‑hour activity, indicating a temporary lull there. These six fronts dominate the tactical picture and are the likeliest sources of further base‑ownership shifts in the coming day.
